text: Add a no-change guard to the producer stage. When the producer finishes with an empty diff, require it to state a reason: what it tried and what blocked it, such as an unobtainable tool checksum or too many surfaces for one run. Record that reason, and end the job as 'no change' with that diagnosis, instead of sending back the generic unmet-criteria list. Add a test where a producer that makes no change produces a recorded no-change outcome that includes its reason.
